items.t: CHIPOTLE BRINGS BACK "BACK HOME BOGO" FOR THE BIGGEST REUNION NIGHT OF THE YEAR
items.sum: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE: CMG) today announced the return of its popular Back Home BOGO for Thanksgiving Eve. On Wednesday, November 25, Chipotle Rewards members who purchase an entrée in-restaurant from 5 to 9 p.m. local time and scan their Chipotle Rewards member card at checkout can receive a second entrée free.1

items.t: Can Brisket Help Chipotle Exit 2026 With 3%-4% Comp Growth?
